interactions.flavorLineOne: You've been at Gambit for a while now. You've met the enemies of Humanity head-on and made them pay. The Drifter has rewarded you handsomely for the Motes of Dark you've collected. Now it's time to see the culmination of your partnership with the Drifter.
Drifter's smile never falters as he accepts the delicious chocolate treats.
"Hey, I see you. I know what you're about. Come to the Tower. A Guardian like you should get to know a fella like me. The benefits would be… mutual." —The Drifter

Drifter stands up straight and slides something quickly out of view behind his back.

"Well, well, what can I do for—oh, it's you, hero. That's a mighty fine mask you got on there. Almost fooled 'ol Drifter. 'Cept for the, uh, tape you got hanging there."

You inquire about the missing grab bags, but he shakes his head.

"That's the kind of trouble you'll never find me lookin' for. Last thing I want is to end up as Eva's next Dawning cookie!"

He mentions hearing rumors about Exo boot prints leading out of the storage room where Eva keeps her extra grab bags.

He shudders. "But if Eva asks, you didn't hear that from me."

headerDisplayProperties.name: The Mystery of the Missing Bags

interactions.flavorLineOne:
Drifter flashes a crooked smile as you walk up. "Nice work, hotshot," he says. "You're almost ready to go grab that gun."

"According to those blueprints, the one thing the Fallen haven't worked out yet is how to stabilize the Stasis energy. So I whipped up a prototype of my own." He winks. "This should help you get the gun firing."

Return to Europa and complete the "Stealing Stasis" mission.

"Like I said, kid; when Drifter wins, you win. Don't ever say I didn't do anything for you.

"Whenever you feel like making some more cheddar, you come on back. Don't be shy about it; Gambit's always here, and Drifter never forgets his friends."
You found a component part of some kind of weapon at Callum's grave. It must be what he stole from the Drifter. He'd probably like it back.
You've defeated a particularly powerful Primeval in Gambit and taken its heart. Drifter might find it valuable. Take it to him.
Drifter is impressed. He admires the gun and asks you to bring it through Gambit sometime. This weapon could really shake things up.

"Hey, hero." Drifter has a familiar insouciance as he greets you.

"Got something here for you. Some kind of challenge. Yeah, I know you're up for anything. Whaddaya think: your greatest foes, given renewed strength? Sound good?"

The bravado falls away a little. Drifter's look is briefly sympathetic.

"It's only gonna get worse," he reminds you. "Whatever the Nine put in front of their Weapon. You can kill anything, Guardian. Time to prove it."

He's back to a grin inside of a moment.

"And hey, you'll get a good prize out of it! That's what I'm talking about."
Visit the Drifter in the Annex.

"I knew you'd be back before too long. Old Drifter presents opportunities that are too good to pass up…

"Here's the game, kid; it's called Gambit, a friendly competition between Guardians with the Darkness sandwiched in the middle. Every time you play, I get some cheese, and I kick some of that back to my friend, you dig?

"And when I say friend, I mean you. We're in this together, you see? When you win, Drifter wins, and when Drifter wins, you win. Heck of a scheme if I say so myself.

"So get out there and give it a spin, yeah?"

The Drifter examines the blueprints you found. Turns out that the Fallen are using Praksis's armor tech to create a weapon capable of channeling Stasis energy. Eramis had plans to distribute this weaponry to Fallen all across the system, expanding the capabilities of her army.

Drifter likes the idea so much that he immediately cooks up a plan to steal the prototype from the Fallen. He thinks Spider's associates might be able to offer some insider information too. While he looks over the blueprints and calls in a favor, he asks you to go to Europa and gather more intel on the prototype.
Compete in Gambit. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.
